mission.title: Mjolnir bootc fleet operations
mission.description: Inspect, upgrade and reboot a fleet of Mjolnir bootc nodes. Reboots are drained and coordinated by kured.

steps.title: Verify the MjolnirNode CRD and publisher
steps.description: Confirm the CRD is installed and every node publishes status.
steps.failureHandling: Apply plugins/console/crds/mjolnirnodes.yaml and check the mjolnir-fleet-publish timer on the node.

steps.title: Verify kured is running on every node
steps.description: kured watches /run/reboot-required via a hostPath mount, drains the node and reboots it with a cluster-wide lock.

validation.command: kubectl -n kube-system get ds kured -o jsonpath='{.status.numberReady}'
validation.expected: equal to the number of nodes

steps.failureHandling: Apply plugins/console/manifests/kured.yaml; ensure hostPID is enabled and the node can signal PID 1.

steps.title: Read live node status over mTLS Varlink
steps.description: The fleet service exposes io.mjolnir.Fleet over varlink-httpd on port 1031.

steps.title: Queue a bootc update without rebooting
steps.description: Download and stage a new image; the node reports updateAvailable=true after staging.

steps.title: Request a coordinated reboot
steps.description: The Varlink action writes /run/reboot-required; kured drains the node, reboots it and uncordons it on return.

validation.expected: the new image version after the node returns

steps.failureHandling: If the cluster-wide kured lock is held, clear it with: kubectl -n kube-system annotate ds kured weave.works/kured-node-lock-

steps.title: Hold reboots cluster-wide (maintenance window)
steps.description: Set kured's lock annotation to block reboots; release it explicitly when the window opens.
commands: kubectl -n kube-system annotate ds kured weave.works/kured-node-lock-

validation.expected: empty after the lock is released

steps.title: Rotate the worker join token (control plane only)
steps.description: Create a fresh bootstrap token and update the provisioning credential on new workers.

validation.expected: a new unused token with a TTL

resolution.summary: Mjolnir nodes report status as MjolnirNode resources, bootc updates are staged through Varlink, and kured drains and reboots nodes under a cluster-wide lock.

troubleshooting.action: Check that the fleet-kubeconfig credential is provisioned and that mjolnir-fleet-publish.timer is active on the node.

troubleshooting.symptom: A node never reboots after an update
troubleshooting.action: Check /run/reboot-required on the node, the kured pod logs, and the cluster-wide kured lock annotation.

prerequisites.description: A Mjolnir kubeadm cluster with the Console plugin CRD and kured applied, and mTLS client credentials for Varlink.
